title: Fountain plaza: paths re-laid
caption: The plaza's paths laid out again from a plan. The lane comes in and goes out on one straight axis through the fountain, the loop round the plaza is gone, and the canteen has its own terrace with a wall and one link to the plaza on its door's axis. The lane, fountain, paving and canteen themselves are unchanged.

sections.title: The plan
sections.caption: Seen from straight above, before and after, and the plan drawing it was built from. Two axes cross at the fountain: the lane east-west, the canteen door north-south. The ring bed runs all round the plaza, open only for the two lanes and the link.

sections.title: Coming in from head office
sections.caption: Eric arrives on the lane just short of the circle and walks in along the axis toward the fountain. The circle's dark border ring crosses the lane's mouth.

sections.title: The canteen link
sections.caption: The terrace ends in its seat-height wall along its whole front, open only on the door's axis. A short link in the lane's brick and borders crosses a strip of lawn and the ring bed to the circle, a lamp and a maple either side.

sections.title: Out toward the dorms
sections.caption: The lane leaves the circle on the same axis it came in on, in the same brick, and the walk to the dorm courtyard starts on it.
